title: Hamster waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='27' ry='24' fill='#e8a33d'/>
  <!-- lighter belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='17' ry='16' fill='#f6d08a'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='40' r='24' fill='#e8a33d'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='31' cy='20' r='9' fill='#e8a33d'/>
  <circle cx='31' cy='20' r='5' fill='#f6a3a3'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='20' r='9' fill='#e8a33d'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='20' r='5' fill='#f6a3a3'/>
  <!-- cheek patches -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='48' r='8' fill='#f6c9a0'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='48' r='8' fill='#f6c9a0'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='50' rx='13' ry='10' fill='#f6d08a'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='38' r='4.5' fill='#2a1a3a'/>
  <circle cx='41.5' cy='36.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='61.5' cy='36.5' r='1.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#c96b8a'/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d='M50 49 q -5 6 -9 3' stroke='#c96b8a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M50 49 q 5 6 9 3' stroke='#c96b8a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <line x1='20' y1='46' x2='34' y2='48' stroke='#b57a2a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='20' y1='52' x2='34' y2='52' stroke='#b57a2a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='80' y1='46' x2='66' y2='48' stroke='#b57a2a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <line x1='80' y1='52' x2='66' y2='52' stroke='#b57a2a' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- left arm (down) -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='70' rx='6' ry='9' fill='#e8a33d' transform='rotate(20 24 70)'/>
  <!-- waving right arm up -->
  <ellipse cx='82' cy='46' rx='6' ry='11' fill='#e8a33d' transform='rotate(28 82 46)'/>
  <!-- waving paw -->
  <circle cx='87' cy='35' r='6.5' fill='#f6d08a'/>
  <ellipse cx='91' cy='31' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#e8a33d' transform='rotate(30 91 31)'/>
  <ellipse cx='87' cy='29' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#e8a33d'/>
  <ellipse cx='83' cy='31' rx='2' ry='3' fill='#e8a33d' transform='rotate(-30 83 31)'/>
  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='35' cy='90' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#f6d08a'/>
  <ellipse cx='65' cy='90' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#f6d08a'/>
</svg>
